# afs/

Annual Financial Statements engine — IFRS / IFRS-for-SMEs packs (BS/IS/CF/notes) from GL, renders to HTML/DOCX/PDF, review workflow, portal delivery. Largest single module (42 files).

## Modules
- **Document + version**: `afsDocumentService.ts` (a "document" = one year × company), `afsSectionService.ts` (20+ ordered sections), `afsVersionHistoryService.ts`, `afsGenerationJobService.ts` (async job queue `queued → running → complete|failed`), `afsTypes.ts`.
- **Mapping**: `afsMappingService.ts` — COA → AFS line mapping.
- **Note engine**: `noteEngineService.ts` (4-stage: fetch → generate → suppress → persist), `noteDataQueryService.ts`, `noteTemplateRegistry.ts`, `noteRendererService.ts`, `noteAiService.ts` (AI narrative for qualitative), `noteGenerators/` (one file per note: PPE, intangibles, tax, leases…).
- **Statement calculators**: `cashFlowDirectService.ts`, `cashFlowReconciliationService.ts`, `changesInEquityService.ts`, `pisCalculatorService.ts` (Public Interest Score — Companies Act reg 26 → audit/review/compiled), `kpiScorecardService.ts`.
- **Rendering / export**: `afsHtmlRendererService.ts`, `afsHtmlCoverTemplates.ts`, `afsHtmlTableRenderer.ts`, `docxExportService.ts`, `docxTableRenderer.ts`, `pdfExportService.ts`, `weasyprintService.ts` (Python WeasyPrint HTTP service), `serverChartSvg.ts`, `casewareExportExtService.ts`.
- **Branding / templates**: `brandProfileService.ts`, `imageLibraryService.ts`, `reportTemplates.ts`, `entityTerminology.ts` (Company/CC/Trust label swap).
- **Review workflow**: `afsReviewService.ts` (`draft → review → approved → issued`), `afsSectionCommentService.ts`, `afsPreExportChecks.ts` (blocker gate).
- **Proof / signing**: `afsProofCopyService.ts`, `signumIntegrationService.ts` (e-signature), `cipcFilingGuideService.ts`.
- **Compliance**: `complianceCheckerService.ts` (IFRS structural/mathematical/disclosure checks), `complianceAlertService.ts`. The AFS filing deadline is ONE rule, `afsFilingDeadline.ts` (last day of the sixth month after year end; an unusable `financial_year_start` throws `FilingDeadlineUnknownError`, no March fallback), read by the alert detector and by `reports/statutoryFilingsService`. `cashFlowDirectService` logs a failure by class and SQLSTATE only. With an unusable year start the alert detector fires ONE visible alert, `afs_filing_deadline_unknown` ("AFS filing deadline cannot be assessed: the financial year start is not set"), not a server warning alone — an empty alert list reads as "nothing is due". That alert is withdrawn (system: `dismissed_by` null) in any run that does not raise it, and is not raised again while a USER-dismissed row of its type exists. Types: `afsTypes.ts` re-exports `afsReviewTypes.ts` (review workflow, portal) and `afsComplianceTypes.ts` (PIS, compliance, CIPC, alerts) — add new types to the cohesive file, not back into `afsTypes.ts`.
- **Management pack**: `managementPackConfigService.ts`, `managementPackGeneratorService.ts`, `packAiSummaryService.ts`, `packSchedulerService.ts`, `packDeliveryService.ts`.
- **Portal (client-facing review/approval)**: `portalContactsService.ts`, `magicLinkService.ts` (30-min single-use tokens), `portalNotificationService.ts`.

## Caller contract
Invoked by `withCompany`-wrapped API routes in `pages/api/accounting/afs/*` and `pages/api/portal/afs/*`. Every public function takes `companyId` first (or documentId+companyId). `weasyprintService` shells out over HTTP to a separate Python service.

## Main function signatures
- `enqueueGenerationJob(companyId, documentId, userId): Promise<AfsGenerationJob>` / `markJobStarted / markJobComplete`.
- `generateSection(companyId, documentId, sectionKey): Promise<AfsSection>` / `generateAllSections(...)` — note-engine orchestrator.
- `markSectionReviewed / signOffSection / submitDocumentForReview(companyId, documentId, userId)`.
- `getCashFlowDirect(companyId, yearStart, yearEnd)` — direct-method cash flow.
- `runComplianceCheck(companyId, documentId)` — IFRS structural/math/disclosure.
- `createMagicLink(contactId, documentId): Promise<{ token }>` / `verifyMagicLink(token)` — single-use, 30-min expiry, atomic consume.
- `deliverPack(documentId, companyId)` / `scheduleDelivery(companyId, documentId, config)`.

## Business rules
- Section order and keys are fixed in `reportTemplates` / `noteTemplateRegistry`. Add new notes via `noteGenerators/` + registry entry.
- Document state machine: `draft → review → approved → issued`; `afsPreExportChecks` runs before `issued` and blocks on imbalances / missing mandatory notes.
- PIS calculator drives outcome (audit/review/compiled) — required before generation.
- Magic-link tokens are single-use and consumed atomically inside `verifyMagicLink` (UPDATE…RETURNING with `used_at IS NULL` guard).
- Portal contacts are a separate auth path — magic link only, no password; tenant scope enforced by joining `portal_contacts.company_id`.
- WeasyPrint runs out-of-process — handle timeouts; large packs may hit connection reset.
- Version history: every generation snapshots the rendered output so earlier drafts are recoverable; callers NEVER overwrite in place.

## Related files
- `pages/api/accounting/afs/*.ts`, `pages/api/portal/afs/*.ts` — routes.
- `src/modules/accounting/services/reports/disclosureNoteService.ts` — companion disclosure generators.
- `scripts/migrations/sql/333-345_*` — AFS engine schema (documents, sections, jobs, portal, PIS).

## Recent changes
- 2026-10-18 (G-01 review): the posted year-end close (source 'year_end') is skipped by every AFS reader, so anything that reads POSTED equity must add the derived profit, as the balance sheet does (`reports/balanceSheetService.calculateRetainedEarnings`): the Statement of Financial Position adds it to BS045 "Accumulated profit (loss)", current and prior column (`primaryStatements/derivedAccumulatedProfit.ts`; it also fixes a company that never closed, whose SFP never carried unclosed profit), Note 12 adds it to the retained-earnings row, and `afsKpiService.fetchBalanceSnapshot.totalEquity` adds it for debt-to-equity. Pinned by `tests/integration/g01-afs-equity-ties-out.int.test.ts`.
- 2026-10-19 (G-01, Hein): the pre-export "Every mapped account is on the right statement" warning (`afsMappingSectionCheck.ts`) gives an equity account mapped to IS484 "Dividends paid" its own advice (the income statement shows it, but balance-sheet equity does not yet take it from the accumulated profit, so the balance sheet will not balance); every other misplacement keeps the "remap" advice. Pinned by `tests/unit/services/afs/afsMappingSectionCheck.test.ts` and `g01-afs-mapping-and-compliance.int.test.ts`.
- 2026-10-16 (migration 894): `companies.entity_type` holds an SA entity code from `src/lib/entityTypes.ts` (sole_proprietor, partnership, pty_ltd, ltd, cc, npc, trust, other), no longer the AFS key. `getCompanyTerminology` maps it with `afsTemplateFor`: pty_ltd/ltd/npc → pty, cc → cc, trust → trust, anything else (sole proprietor, partnership, other, NULL) → the pty fallback it always used. No company's AFS output changes. The AFS template keys stay `pty|cc|trust` (`AFS_TEMPLATE_KEYS`).
- 2026-10-07 (K-091g): `afsKpiCash.fetchOpeningCash`/`fetchClosingCash` and `cashFlowReconciliationService`'s `fetchIndirectClosingCash`/`fetchBankBalance` read `bank/cashBalanceService.getCashBalance` (cash.balance.v1; opening = `{ exclusive: true }`) instead of their own copies of the cash query, which signed each account by `normal_balance` and summed a credit-normal petty cash float as negative cash. Tests: `tests/unit/services/cashSitesReadCashBalance.test.ts` (each site reports getCashBalance's figure on the right date bound), `tests/integration/k091g-credit-normal-cash-account.int.test.ts` (disposable DB only).
- 2026-09-26 (R-032 L5): `signOffSection`, `signOffDocument` now call `assertNotImpersonating()` (`src/lib/auth/impersonationGuard.ts`) as their FIRST statement: a platform-admin "Login as" session gets `ImpersonationForbiddenError` → 403 `IMPERSONATION_FORBIDDEN` before anything is read or written. Bearer callers (MCP, PATs) and jobs carry no `session_id` and pass. The guard runs one `sql` query, so a unit test that mocks `sql` with a positional queue must also mock the guard (`vi.mock('@/lib/auth/impersonationGuard', ...)` with `assertNotImpersonating: async () => undefined`) or every later query shifts by one.
- 2026-09-06: `serverChartSvg.ts` moved in from `services/packs/`. It renders an ECharts option to an SVG STRING because the statutory PDF path goes through WeasyPrint, which runs no JavaScript — so a chart has to arrive already drawn. It registers its own narrow ECharts module set (SVG renderer only) rather than `src/lib/charts/echarts.ts`, which registers the canvas renderer and is client-only, so it is safe to import in a Node request handler. Its only consumer is `pdfExportService.ts`. The default palette still comes from `services/packs/packChartOptions.ts`, so an AFS chart and a pack chart are the same colours.
